early.label: Early
early.name: The Jinshen Company
early.context: A first developed full stack—not an instruction to wait for every specialist before clearing Jinshen.
notes: Progression, not a turn-one shopping list
Recruit this as the needed tiers and budget arrive. Retain starting specialists, replace the weakest unit a few at a time, and use a basic troop for an unavailable hero slot.
Supporting-army distinction
A Celestial General gains neither Zhao’s transformation nor his unique personal army bonuses. The Alchemist retains a caster; the supporting force should be budgeted at its own actual upkeep.
Smart Autoresolve
These are thematic, combined-arms recommendations. Inspect the forecast and preserve important troops; they are not benchmark-tested stacks for the mod.
Before the cannon or halberds
Use more available Peasant/Jade troops and starting units. Upgrade to the displayed version when local recruitment exists, without stopping the first war.
One mobile group
The single Lancer is a reserve, not an invitation to manage an elaborate cavalry manoeuvre. Retain a different starting specialist in that slot if useful.
plan: 1 • Build a real line
Put the shielded troops on the obvious approach, anti-large on the threatened side, and keep one unit able to turn around. Do not stretch to cover the entire map.
2 • Support with nearby fire
Keep crossbows close enough to their protectors for battle Harmony. Leave proper lanes for Iron Hail and cannons; stop firing into friendly backs.
3 • One deliberate intervention
Use Zhao, the lions or the single mobile group to fix the dangerous part of the fight. Do not launch every specialist into a separate fight at once.
4 • Restore the formation
After a rout or breakthrough, stop the chase, turn the screen, and select the next high-value target. Keep the backline protected while the enemy’s next wave arrives.
